title: Brutalist button: invert to a theme-aware solid fill
description: The fixed #111 fill was near-invisible on Brutalist's own dark ground - the button read as a hollow outline. Inverted to var(--fg)/var(--bg) the way Luxury's real .cta already is, keeping every other Brutalist button trait.
commit_message: Brutalist: invert button fill to theme-aware var(--fg)/var(--bg)
